subject: Renewal kickoff: launch readiness, uplift cadence, and QBR slotting
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hall <jordan.hall@fathomhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: launch readiness, uplift cadence, and QBR slotting

Hi Jordan / Sana —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our brief, I'd like to kick off the renewal + capacity uplift planning so we can lock dates for onboarding workstreams and schedule a QBR to align execs. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm desired contract term and target commit (you mentioned +30% token throughput as a target).
- Confirm any additional security/evidence requirements (SOC2, encryption-at-rest, VPC).
- Preferred QBR week windows in June/early July (see proposed slots below).

Proposed near-term timeline (flexible):
1) This week (Jun 1–4): mutual action plan (MAP) review and legal pre-read
2) Week of Jun 7: technical onboarding and capacity runbook alignment
3) Week of Jun 21: QBR with execs + formal signature / PO issuance

Proposed QBR slots (please pick 1–2):
- Thu Jun 24, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 30, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri Jul 2, 09:00–10:00 PT

I've attached a first-pass MAP and a redlineable SOW draft for your procurement and legal teams to review. Action items for you: confirm QBR slot preference and whether your procurement needs a vendor form or PO number in advance.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will lead onboarding planning for capacity; David will coordinate commercial/legal questions. If it helps, we can run a short SOC2 evidence package review ahead of the QBR.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_FathomHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Hall <jordan.hall@fathomhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.kapoor@fathomhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: launch readiness, uplift cadence, and QBR slotting

Thanks Irene — this looks good. Quick answers from our side:

- Commit target: we are aiming for a 35% throughput uplift across peak hours (still validating final numbers with infra).
- Term: leaning toward a 12-month renewal with an option to extend at +20% capacity pricing.
- Security: procurement will need SOC2 Type II and a short note on data residency (we use AWS us-west-2).

QBR slot: Wed Jun 30, 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our execs. Sana and I will be on the call; I'll invite our head of procurement if needed.

A couple of asks before the QBR:
1) Can you share the SOC2 evidence pack and a brief security FAQ we can share with our InfoSec?
2) We will likely need a vendor form and a purchase order template — is that something Redwood provides or should our procurement adapt the SOW?

Appreciate the MAP — we'll review and drop comments.

—Jordan
Jordan Hall
Director, Platform Ops
Fathom Health

Jordan — perfect, Wed Jun 30 13:00–14:00 PT is locked on our side. I'll send a calendar invite with agenda and pre-reads.

Responses to your asks:
1) SOC2 evidence: attaching a redacted SOC2 Type II summary and a short security FAQ — Marissa will follow up with the full evidence bundle via secure share once the procurement contact is confirmed.
2) Vendor/PO: Redwood can accept a PO; we also attach a SOW that procurement can return with standard PO fields filled. If your procurement prefers to use Fathom's vendor form, please send it over and David will run the commercial review.

Action items (owner / due):
- Jordan / Sana: confirm procurement contact and send vendor form (if preferred) — due Fri Jun 4
- Marissa: prepare onboarding runbook draft and capacity checklist — due Mon Jun 7
- David: pre-read on commercial updates and any redlines to the SOW — due Mon Jun 7

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_Summary.pdf (pdf), Redwood_Security_FAQ_v1.docx (docx)

Thanks — will see you on Jun 30.

Best,
Irene
